method: each EDGE sprite is placed with its pivot (deck diamond centre) on the pivot of each margin cell of the lattice (margin_cells = 1) and its opaque pixels are intersected with the masks below

summary.c8: no edge pixel lies in ringK0 or ringK4 for any placement counted as clear, so the ring pixels of every badge and marker stay in A_ov / A_fr with zero steel_* contribution from this family; the full ring proof on the densest 12-slot frame per screen class is the composite gate (T525, T527)
remainingForComposite: pixel ring proof on the densest 12-slot frame of every screen class with the final F006 world layers composed (T525, T527)
the depot, deposit and link margin cells are not drawn by this family; their overlap with an edge tile in the same margin cell is a composition rule (T527)
summary.ruleDerived: walls and gantries are drawn only on the front margin row, below the Extent, at least 13 art px from every mask (never next to a machine column). A wall or gantry tile on the back margin row overlaps the Extent, hit shapes, rings and the keep-out; on the left and right margin rows it touches the machine column (gap 1 to 2 px). Those tiles are not drawn there (Art Bible 21.5, 21.8 item 1). The railing overlaps nothing on the front, left and right margin rows and fails on the back row (counts per sprite below)
